name: Venous leg ulcer care
advice: Compression bandage/stockings are the main treatment once pulses/ABPI (≥0.8) are confirmed; walk daily and keep the leg raised when sitting. Tests: Doppler/ABPI, blood sugar, Hb, albumin; swab only if infected; biopsy if not healing in 3 months. Avoid applying many creams (allergy risk).
